review_text: Super love the coffee, and the vibe! I love how accessible it is kay centro ra sa Calinan. Nice sad ang customer service 💯 would recommend!

A new favorite café here in Calinan! The coffee is excellent, and the staff are accommodating. They provide great service and are happy to guide you in choosing a drink that matches your preferences. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a great place to relax or catch up with friends. Plus, they're open until 10 PM, which is perfect for an evening coffee run. Highly recommended!
